key_idea: To make one card big, make the other three cards as small as possible.
steps: The three smallest cards are 2, 3 and 4. They add up to 9.
So the fourth card can be at most 20 - 9 = 11. Card 14 is too big.
There is no 11 card. The next card down is 10.
With 10, the other three must make 10: 2 + 3 + 5 = 10. So 2 + 3 + 5 + 10 = 20.
